Type: cabinet
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Lacquer and Wood Cabinet, 23.6"L, Glossy White and Wood
Colors: White
Materials: Beech Wood Legs; Solid Hardwood
High-gloss white lacquer is combined with wood trim and legs for a true style statement piece. Along with providing extra storage space, this handsome cabinet gives you an eye-catching focal point for an entryway or hallway. 13.8" W x 23.6"L x30.7" H Beech wood legs; solid hardwood coated with white lacquer finish An ultra contemporary style perfect for a modern space This snazzy piece provides storage space along with high style Easy assembly in 15-30 minutes. Wipe with soft dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
